Phir upar wala number aaya, jo batata hai 0 se kitne gap chalna hai; dono milkar ek jagah batate hain. Aakhir mein dekha: upar wala number neeche wale se bada ho, toh fraction 1 ke aage aata hai. Aaj ki padhai mein kuch aisa tha jo achha laga?
